# AudienceIntent

> AudienceIntent gets businesses recommended by AI. It is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) company based in Wellington, Florida, USA, with one fully managed service: AI Recommended™. When people ask ChatGPT, Google AI or Perplexity who to recommend, AudienceIntent works to get the client's name in the answer.
> Last updated: 2026-10-27

AudienceIntent was founded in 2024 by Kevin Bovett. It works with businesses across the United States. It is not a software platform. AudienceIntent does the work.

## The service: AI Recommended™

What's included, every month:
1. Open to crawlers: making sure ChatGPT, Google and Perplexity can access and understand the website
2. Website fixes: schema, sitemap and on-page fixes
3. Customer question research: the real questions customers ask
4. 4 new articles every month (Google leans heavily on recent content)
5. 4 older pages brought up to date every month
6. Weekly visibility report: 50 prompts tracked every day
7. Competitor tracking: up to 5 competitors
8. A real human to speak with: a monthly progress call and a Slack channel

Platforms tracked: ChatGPT, Google AI (AI Overviews and AI Mode), Perplexity.

## Pricing

- Pay monthly: $1,997/month for a 90-day minimum, then $997/month, month to month.
- Pay upfront: $5,000 for the first 90 days (saves $991), then $997/month, month to month.
- The first 90 days are the deep work: technical fixes, research, building the prompt library. From month 4: new content, updating older pages, and tracking against competitors. The price drops on its own.
- Nobody can guarantee a business will appear in a specific answer.

## Results (client examples)

- Vault Metal: AI mentions grew from 169 to 7,808 (+4,520%) and citations from 3 to 751 in 90 days.
- GoldenCrest Metals: +202.4% increase in visibility score within 90 days.
- Craft Food Tours: +312% increase in traffic from AI within 90 days.

## What AudienceIntent does not offer

Paid ads management, social media management, website builds, SMS or text-message marketing, lead reactivation, phone outreach, or self-serve software.
